section.content: The utility model discloses a waterborne binder agitating unit relates to waterborne binder technical field, for solving the lower and relatively poor problem of the degree of consistency of mixing of current agitating unit mixing efficiency. The utility model discloses a stirring tank, including agitator tank, stand, action wheel, cylinder, air cylinder, stand and air cylinder, the stand is installed to the centre of agitator tank upper end, the externally mounted of stand has from the driving wheel, the curb plate is installed to the outside one side of agitator tank, and curb plate and agitator tank welded connection, driving motor is installed to the upper end of curb plate, driving motor's upper end is installed the action wheel, the action wheel passes through the hold-in range with the follow driving wheel and is connected, the agitator tank passes through the bearing with the stand and is connected, the puddler is installed to the lower extreme of stand, and the inside of the upper end embedding stand of puddler, the mount is installed to the upper end of stand, and the mount passes through screw connection with the stand, the cylinder passes through coupling joint with the puddler including the air rod, and the air rod.

本实用新型公开了一种水性粘结剂搅拌装置，涉及水性粘结剂技术领域，为解决现有的搅拌装置混合效率较低且混合均匀度较差的问题。所述搅拌罐上端的中间安装有立柱，所述立柱的外部安装有从动轮，所述搅拌罐外部的一侧安装有侧板，且侧板与搅拌罐焊接连接，所述侧板的上端安装有驱动电机，所述驱动电机的上端安装有主动轮，所述主动轮与从动轮通过同步带连接，所述搅拌罐与立柱通过轴承连接，所述立柱的下端安装有搅拌杆，且搅拌杆的上端嵌入立柱的内部，所述立柱的上端安装有固定架，且固定架与立柱通过螺钉连接，所述固定架的内侧安装有气缸，且固定架与气缸通过螺钉连接，所述气缸包括气杆，且气杆与搅拌杆通过联轴器连接。

Aqueous binder stirring deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a waterborne binder technical field specifically is a waterborne binder agitating unit.

Background

The water-based adhesive is mainly dried or bonded by absorbing water on the surface, raw solid starch in the adhesive is gelatinized on a pasting line to absorb water, the bonding time is about several seconds to one minute, the water is gradually absorbed by surrounding air and paper fibers, the adhesive in the traditional mode is generally used for a corrugated board production line, the firm bonding effect can be immediately generated, in order to achieve the satisfactory bonding effect, a slightly viscous suspoemulsion which contains pre-gelatinized starch is added into starch and water emulsion, in order to achieve the satisfactory bonding effect, borax is also added, the proper viscosity and toughness are generated when the starch is gelatinized, and in the production process of the water-based adhesive, a stirring device is required to be used for fully stirring and mixing all ingredients.

However, the existing stirring device has low mixing efficiency and poor mixing uniformity, so the existing requirement is not met, and the water-based binder stirring device is provided.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a waterborne binder agitating unit to solve the lower and relatively poor problem of the degree of consistency of mixing of the current agitating unit mixing efficiency that provides among the above-mentioned background art.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a water-based binder stirring device comprises a stirring tank, wherein the middle of the upper end of the stirring tank is provided with a vertical column, a driven wheel is arranged outside the upright post, a side plate is arranged on one side outside the stirring tank, the side plate is welded with the stirring tank, the upper end of the side plate is provided with a driving motor, the upper end of the driving motor is provided with a driving wheel, the driving wheel is connected with the driven wheel through a synchronous belt, the stirring tank is connected with the upright post through a bearing, the lower end of the upright post is provided with a stirring rod, the upper end of the stirring rod is embedded into the upright post, the upper end of the upright post is provided with a fixing frame, the fixing frame is connected with the upright post through a screw, the inner side of the fixing frame is provided with a cylinder, and the fixing frame is connected with the air cylinder through a screw, the air cylinder comprises an air rod, the air rod is connected with the stirring rod through a coupler, and the stirring rod is connected with the stand column in a sliding mode.

Preferably, the upper end of puddler is provided with the mounting, first actuating arm is all installed to the both sides of mounting, the second actuating arm is installed to the one end of first actuating arm, and puddler and mounting fixed connection, and first actuating arm is connected through the pivot with the mounting, and first actuating arm is connected through the pivot with the second actuating arm.

Preferably, a heating sleeve is arranged outside the stirring tank, an electric heating plate is arranged inside the heating sleeve, the heating sleeve is connected with the electric heating plate through screws, and an electric heating tube is arranged inside the electric heating plate.

Preferably, the temperature controller is installed at the front end of the stirring tank and is connected with the stirring tank through screws.

Preferably, the other side of the outside of the stirring tank is provided with a feed hopper.

Preferably, the discharging pipe is installed in the middle of the lower end of the stirring tank, a valve is installed outside the discharging pipe, and the discharging pipe is connected with the valve through a flange.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. the utility model discloses a driving motor work drives the action wheel and rotates, drive from driving wheel synchronous rotation through synchronous belt drive, make stand and puddler horizontal rotation stir the inside batching of agitator tank, at the in-process of stirring, cylinder work drive puddler axial reciprocating motion, because the waterborne binder batching has certain viscidity, thereby certain stagnation power has, force first actuating arm and second actuating arm for the mounting luffing motion, the swing power realizes the upper and lower stirring to the waterborne binder batching, a plurality of stirring direction in the stirring process have improved the mixing efficiency and the mixing uniformity to the waterborne binder batching.

2. The utility model discloses an electrothermal tube circular telegram intensifies the heating electric plate, again through the heating jacket with heat transfer to agitator tank, heats the inside waterborne binder batching of agitator tank, the inside temperature of temperature controller real-time supervision agitator tank to the break-make electricity of corresponding control electrothermal tube realizes the constant temperature heating to the agitator tank, makes the stirring mixing action be in the best temperature scope, thereby further improves the mixing quality to the waterborne binder batching.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural view of an aqueous binder stirring apparatus according to the present invention;

fig. 2 is a front view of an aqueous binder stirring apparatus according to the present invention;

fig. 3 is a schematic structural view of the electric heating plate of the present invention.

In the figure: 1. a stirring tank; 2. a column; 3. a driven wheel; 4. a side plate; 5. a drive motor; 6. a driving wheel; 7. a synchronous belt; 8. a bearing; 9. a stirring rod; 10. a fixed mount; 11. a cylinder; 12. a fixing member; 13. a first drive arm; 14. a second drive arm; 15. heating a jacket; 16. an electric hot plate; 17. an electric heating tube; 18. a temperature controller; 19. a feed hopper; 20. a discharge pipe; 21. and (4) a valve.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments.

Referring to fig. 1-3, the present invention provides an embodiment: a water-based binder stirring device comprises a stirring tank 1, wherein a stand column 2 is installed in the middle of the upper end of the stirring tank 1, a driven wheel 3 is installed outside the stand column 2, a side plate 4 is installed on one side of the outside of the stirring tank 1, the side plate 4 is welded with the stirring tank 1, a driving motor 5 is installed at the upper end of the side plate 4, a driving wheel 6 is installed at the upper end of the driving motor 5, the driving wheel 6 is connected with the driven wheel 3 through a synchronous belt 7, the stirring tank 1 is connected with the stand column 2 through a bearing 8, a stirring rod 9 is installed at the lower end of the stand column 2, the upper end of the stirring rod 9 is embedded into the stand column 2, a fixing frame 10 is installed at the upper end of the stand column 2, the fixing frame 10 is connected with the stand column 2 through screws, an air cylinder 11 is installed on the inner side of the fixing frame 10, the fixing frame 10 is connected with the air cylinder 11 through screws, the air cylinder 11 comprises an air rod, and the air rod is connected with the stirring rod 9 through a coupler, and puddler 9 and stand 2 sliding connection, driving motor 5 work drives action wheel 6 and rotates, drives from driving wheel 3 synchronous revolution through the synchronous belt 7 transmission, makes stand 2 and puddler 9 horizontal rotation, stirs the aqueous binder batching of agitator tank 1 inside, and in the in-process of stirring, cylinder 11 work drives puddler 9 axial reciprocating motion.

Further, the upper end of puddler 9 is provided with mounting 12, first actuating arm 13 is all installed to the both sides of mounting 12, second actuating arm 14 is installed to the one end of first actuating arm 13, and puddler 9 and mounting 12 fixed connection, and first actuating arm 13 is connected through the pivot with mounting 12, and first actuating arm 13 is connected through the pivot with second actuating arm 14, because the water-based adhesive batching has certain viscidity, thereby certain hysteresis power has, at puddler 9 axial reciprocating motion's in-process, force first actuating arm 13 and second actuating arm 14 for mounting 12 luffing motion, the oscillating force can realize the upper and lower stirring to the water-based adhesive batching, a plurality of stirring directions in the stirring process have improved mixing efficiency and the mixing uniformity to the water-based adhesive batching.

Further, a heating sleeve 15 is arranged outside the stirring tank 1, an electric heating plate 16 is arranged inside the heating sleeve 15, the heating sleeve 15 is connected with the electric heating plate 16 through screws, an electric heating tube 17 is arranged inside the electric heating plate 16, the electric heating tube 17 is electrified to heat the electric heating plate 16 in the stirring process, heat is transferred to the stirring tank 1 through the heating sleeve 15, and the water-based binder ingredients inside the stirring tank 1 are heated.

Further, a temperature controller 18 is installed at the front end of the stirring tank 1, the temperature controller 18 is connected with the stirring tank 1 through screws, the temperature controller 18 monitors the internal temperature of the stirring tank 1 in real time, and correspondingly controls the on-off of the electric heating tube 17 to realize constant-temperature heating of the stirring tank 1, so that stirring and mixing actions are within an optimal temperature range.

Further, a feed hopper 19 is provided on the other side of the outside of the agitation tank 1, the aqueous binder is poured into the inside of the agitation tank 1 through the feed hopper 19, and the quantitative suspoemulsion and boron are also poured into the inside of the agitation tank 1 through the feed hopper 19.

Further, a discharge pipe 20 is installed in the middle of the lower end of the stirring tank 1, a valve 21 is installed outside the discharge pipe 20, the discharge pipe 20 is connected with the valve 21 through a flange, and after stirring is completed, the valve 21 is opened, so that the water-based binder can be discharged through the discharge pipe 20.

The working principle is as follows: when the stirring device is used, firstly, the water-based binder is poured into the stirring tank 1 through the feed hopper 19, then, quantitative emulsion and borax are poured into the stirring tank 1 through the feed hopper 19, the driving wheel 6 is driven to rotate by the driving motor 5, the driven wheel 3 is driven to synchronously rotate by the transmission of the synchronous belt 7, the upright post 2 and the stirring rod 9 horizontally rotate, the water-based binder ingredients in the stirring tank 1 are stirred, the stirring rod 9 is driven to axially reciprocate by the cylinder 11 in the stirring process, the water-based binder ingredients have certain viscosity and certain blocking force, the first driving arm 13 and the second driving arm 14 are forced to vertically swing relative to the fixing piece 12 in the axial reciprocating motion process of the stirring rod 9, the swinging force can realize vertical stirring of the water-based binder ingredients, and the mixing efficiency and mixing of the water-based binder ingredients are improved through a plurality of stirring directions in the stirring process, in the stirring process, the electric heating tube 17 is electrified to heat the electric heating plate 16, heat is transferred to the stirring tank 1 through the heating sleeve 15, the water-based binder ingredients in the stirring tank 1 are heated, the temperature controller 18 monitors the internal temperature of the stirring tank 1 in real time, and correspondingly controls the on-off of the electric heating tube 17, so that the constant-temperature heating of the stirring tank 1 is realized, the stirring and mixing actions are in the optimal temperature range, the mixing quality of the water-based binder ingredients is further improved, and after the stirring is finished, the valve 21 is opened, so that the water-based binder can be discharged through the discharging tube 20.

It is obvious to a person skilled in the art that the invention is not restricted to details of the above-described exemplary embodiments, but that it can be implemented in other specific forms without departing from the spirit or essential characteristics of the invention. The present embodiments are therefore to be considered in all respects as illustrative and not restrictive, the scope of the invention being indicated by the appended claims rather than by the foregoing description, and all changes which come within the meaning and range of equivalency of the claims are therefore intended to be embraced therein. Any reference sign in a claim should not be construed as limiting the claim concerned.
